message.content: {"research_brief": "How can I link the Lazarus Group/APT38—while clearly distinguishing confirmed facts, public allegations, analytic assessments, and unresolved uncertainty—to the Ronin Bridge and Harmony Horizon cryptocurrency thefts by investigating, using only evidence returned by the benchmark tools and source IDs provided by those tools, (1) public attribution statements from governments, law-enforcement agencies, cybersecurity firms, blockchain investigators, and other relevant sources; (2) similarities and differences in laundering methods, including transaction flows, intermediary services, bridges, mixers, exchanges, asset conversions, timing, and obfuscation techniques; and (3) wallet and blockchain evidence, including wallet addresses, fund movements, behavioral patterns, and any supported relationships among entities, while avoiding invented facts and unsupported IDs or relationship names, and producing a complete Markdown report as of October 1, 2026 that explicitly states uncertainty, identifies contradictions, cites only returned source IDs, and ends with a fenced JSON object containing arrays named `findings`, `claims`, `reasoning_steps`, and `contradictions`, where each finding includes `question`, `answer`, `supporting_entities`, and `source_references`, each claim includes `claim` and `source_references`, each reasoning step includes `id`, `conclusion`, `premise_entities`, and `premise_relations`, and each contradiction includes `contradiction_id`, `description`, and `source_references`?"}
